correctness.rationale: Wuebben's current primary source supplies the two nonstandard geometric inputs: \(X_C\) has one singularity analytically equal to the anticanonical cone over \(\mathbb F_1\), and its smooth crepant resolution has \((h^{1,1},h^{2,1})=(4,108)\). The cone link is the unit circle bundle of \(K_{\mathbb F_1}\). With \(K=-2S-3F\), fresh intersection arithmetic gives \(K\cdot S=-1\) and \(K\cdot F=-2\), so the Euler class is primitive, the circle bundle is simply connected, and its Gysin sequence has \(H^2\cong H^3\cong\mathbb Z\) with no torsion. Because \(w_2(\mathbb F_1)\equiv -K\pmod2\) pulls back to zero, the link is spin; Smale--Barden then gives \(S^2\times S^3\). The resolution Euler characteristic is \(2(4-108)=-208\), and replacing the exceptional \(\mathbb F_1\), of Euler characteristic four, by a point gives \(-211\). Odd Euler characteristic excludes rational Poincaré duality in formal dimension six.
